scope: Post-tag test-fixture maintenance only; no product runtime, installation package, release tag, or model behavior was changed.

before.case: failed completion stays in the shared journal outbox and restart never duplicates native creation
before.failurePhase: Temporary journal directory teardown while a runner could still finish a journal write.
before.workerDiagnostic: Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved
before.rootCause: The directory-removal after hook was registered before runner-stop hooks, and the original runner in this case had no failure-safe stop hook. The completion-call counter was not a durable completion/teardown barrier.

cleanupRetry.operation: fs.rm on the synthetic temporary fixture directory only

fix.outboxBarrier: The synthetic 503 outage remains active until the original runner is stopped. The test verifies a persisted completion with completionAcknowledged=false, then restarts and waits for persisted completionAcknowledged=true.

limitations: This is a local macOS Node integration/fixture regression, not a new hosted CI result.
No product package was rebuilt for this test-only change.
No private temporary paths, raw logs, credentials, or real account data are included.
